name: topview-3d-builder
description: Build, check and render 3D director scenes on your own machine with the topview-3d-cli command: characters, poses, props, cameras and keyframes. Building and rendering run offline; the last step can hand the frames to an image or video generation service once you confirm.

interface.longDescription:
Topview 3D Builder is a 3D director's stage for AI video. You describe the scene, and your agent builds it in 3D: who stands where, who faces what, what they hold, and where the camera sits. That 3D scene then guides the video model, so the staging comes from you instead of from luck.
It covers the whole path from an idea, to a 3D scene, to a real animated video. The 3D scene fixes blocking, scale and camera angles. Texture, lighting and performance come from the video model.
defaultPrompt: A person by a sports car in a showroom. One 10-second shot: low by the front wheel, to the person's face, then rising and orbiting to reveal the car from above.7s
Rooftop runner front-flips across a gap and keeps running; camera tracks from behind.8s
Rider on horseback in city traffic nears a red light; high rear shot, then cut to horse's POV at the crosswalk.10s
